title: Serino 2015 · Hand and trunk software assessment
citation: Serino et al. (2015). Body part-centered and full body-centered peripersonal space representations. Scientific Reports, 5, 18603.
notes: Software assessment of Experiment 4. Runs the 480-trial pool with separately labelled hand and sternum blocks, virtual looming and receding pink noise, a single software tactile channel and mouse-click responses. The physical hand posture, two-speaker output, stimulation sites and button timing require the original apparatus and calibration.

published_method.hand_posture: Hand beside the sternum without contact.
published_method.response: Speeded gamepad response to tactile onset. Compare distance-dependent facilitation by stimulated site.

software_assessment.timing_reference: Offsets are derived from nominal 22 cm/s motion between 100 and 5 cm, starting at the far endpoint for approach and at the near endpoint for recession. The physical trigger offsets are unavailable.
software_assessment.sound: Two continuous synthetic pink-noise clips use the same virtual frontal path with reversed direction. Each clip holds its final virtual position for 100 ms so the last tactile cue can complete.
software_assessment.tactile_and_response: The same 100 ms software tactile cue and mouse response are used in both site conditions. The block label records which site is intended. The software does not switch an actuator or verify body placement.
software_assessment.block_allocation: Four 120-trial software blocks, two for each tactile site. Each block includes 96 paired, 16 tactile-only and 8 sound-only trials.
software_assessment.intervals: The software balances 500 and 700 ms gaps within the published range, using a deterministic seed.
software_assessment.source: Article pp. 5–6, Experiment 4 and Fig. 4A, and pp. 11–13, Stimuli and Apparatus and Design and Analysis.

source_provenance.value: Supplement documents noise synthesis with SoundForge 4.5 for the 2-speaker setup.
source_provenance.gap: Exact waveform and channel assets unlocated.

trajectory_path.value: Apparent approach or recession between fixed near and far speakers.
trajectory_path.gap: Main Methods report 100 cm speaker separation. Fig. 1 and supplement give approximate body-relative endpoints.

stimulus_duration.gap: Exact acoustic file duration unavailable. Do not derive it from nominal range until onset position and silence are established.

value.shape: exponential overall level change with opposing speaker activation

gain_envelope.gap: Exact channel coefficients and original waveform unknown.

renderer_or_apparatus.value: Two M-Audio Studiophile AV 360 speakers, one near and one far. SoundForge 4.5 synthesis.

condition_intermixing.value: Five to seven distance cells depending on experiment. Bimodal and unimodal control families.
condition_intermixing.gap: Exact scheduling across conditions and order unspecified.

blocked_or_random_order.value: Hand and trunk assessed in separate blocks.
blocked_or_random_order.gap: Exact block count and counterbalance unreported.

iti_jitter_policy.gap: The original values, draw distribution and realized order are unreported.

response_window.gap: Online response deadline and exact gamepad key unreported.

task_sequence_rules.value: Respond quickly to vibration with designated Xbox 360 gamepad button, sampled at 125 Hz. Ignore the moving cue and withhold on no-touch trials.

tactile_stimulus.source: Article pp. 5–6, Experiment 4 and Fig. 4A; Article pp. 11–13, Methods
tactile_stimulus.gap: Separate stimulation-site blocks. Hand near but not touching the sternum.

soa_table.gap: Distances and nominal motion are reported. Exact software onset times, rendering origin and trigger delays are unavailable.

baseline_strategy.value: Two silent tactile timings equivalent to nearest and farthest bimodal samples. Subtract fastest mean tactile-only RT for each participant's comparison.

catch_trial_type.value: Auditory cue with no vibration. Withhold response.

remaining_caveats: The source gives the spatial probe grid and nominal velocity. Original trigger offsets, propagation delays and position-specific sound envelopes are unavailable.
The delivered vibrotactile waveform, actuator acceleration and synchronized gamepad latency require calibration. The 100 ms pulse is the motor command duration.

Match the physical hand posture, the two fixed acoustic speakers and the motor location in each body-site block. The software target channel and mouse response require measured hardware translation before research use.

The original within-site block splits, site order, interval draws and response deadline are unreported. The software run uses four blocks, with two per site, and combines both sound directions at each site.

provenance.source: https://doi.org/10.1038/srep18603. Article pp. 5–6, Experiment 4 and Fig. 4A
